blocks.text: Fresh off the success of his hit drama series ‘Perfect Crown,’ Byeon Woo-seok made his return to Manila with a sold-out fan meeting, ‘The Secret Library,’ at the Mall of Asia Arena on October 10. Having last visited Manila twice in the past, the actor kept his promise to return and create a new chapter of memories with his Filipino fans, fondly known as WooCheTongs. The concept of the fan meeting centered on a magical library, with Woo-seok stepping into the role of a dashing librarian guiding his audience through different chapters of memories.
